long_description:
Forge manages international logistics for business around the world. We’re an AI native freight forwarder, customs broker, and tariff expert.

We’re growing rapidly and support small mom and pop business to the Fortune 1000s, including companies like Allegiant Airlines, Malbon Golf, and R.E.M. beauty.

Forge has raised capital from world class investors including Google, Y-Combinator, and Gradient Ventures.
name: Forge
one_liner: AI native freight forwarder and customs broker
